text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to amend the parking regulations on the west side of Botham Road, in the vicinity of St. Edward Catholic School, to provide a short-term parking area. Approval is also requested to prohibit stopping during the weekday, daytime periods on both sides of Botham Road and Stuart Crescent (south leg) in the vicinity of the school's circular driveway. The proposed parking amendments will address concerns with the lack of on-street parking for student pick-up/drop-offs and will not negatively impact the two-way flow of traffic.
